## Yakusuru 1.1.3, a smoother first run on Windows

Setting up Yakusuru on a fresh Windows PC had a few rough edges. Installing Python stopped the launcher, the hardware check didn't really see AMD and Intel graphics, and whisper.cpp led nowhere. This release smooths all of that out.

### What's fixed

- **Python installs in one go.** After Yakusuru installs Python for you, it now finds the new Python straight away and carries on with the setup, instead of closing and making you start it again.
- **Better hardware detection on Windows.** Yakusuru reads your real processor name and graphics card, including the full amount of video memory, straight from Windows.
- **A dependable engine for AMD and Intel graphics.** PCs without an NVIDIA card now get faster-whisper on the CPU, which works out of the box, instead of a GPU path that had no ready-made download.
- **whisper.cpp installs with a tick.** On Windows and Linux, tick whisper.cpp and press Install, and Yakusuru fetches a ready-made build from GitHub (the GPU build on NVIDIA cards). On a Mac it still comes from Homebrew.
- **The speech model is never a surprise.** The speech model is required, so if it isn't downloaded yet, setup now says so and lets you download it now, download it on the first run, or go back. Pressing Start also tells you the size of the download first, and you can cancel.

### Upgrading

Download **Yakusuru-v1.1.3.zip** below, unzip it, and replace your old Yakusuru folder (or the app in Applications on a Mac). Your settings, glossary, API keys and downloaded models are kept.
